title: Abort if the instance folder cannot be created
diff:
diff --git a/docs/tutorial/factory.rst b/docs/tutorial/factory.rst
index 39febd135f..381477f975 100644
--- a/docs/tutorial/factory.rst
+++ b/docs/tutorial/factory.rst
@@ -56,10 +56,7 @@ directory should be treated as a package.
             app.config.from_mapping(test_config)
